scope: Corollary 4.6 (Comparison with other branches) of the manuscript “Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion” (preprints/Planar-Graph-Metrics-Embed-into-L1-with-Constant-Distortion-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11b3a102e7333bf8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 20-21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Condition on arbitrary prior data. Let W be the union of a nonempty family of band paths issuing from a fixed point x, each of length at most ρ. The set W and these paths are fixed by the prior data. Suppose that Q1, . . . , Qs are interpolation constructions, each on a band component containing all these paths. Their geometries, inputs, and portals are fixed by the prior data, and their fresh noise families are mutually independent. The bands and their intrinsic metrics may differ; each of the specified paths must be permitted in every band. Denote the constants of Qi in (6) by qi, Ni, ρ0,i. Allow inputs ci + εiQi, with εi ∈ {−1, 1} and ci fixed by the prior data. Also allow one fixed branch f and t branches gj + βj, where f and the gj are fixed functions whose restrictions to each specified path, parametrized by arclength, are L-Lipschitz. The βj are fresh independent uniform noises on intervals of length wj > 0, independent also of the interpolation noises. All functions respect the switches used by the paths. Set L∗ = max(1, L), S = 1 + t + s X i=1 Ni, q∗ = min {qi : 1 ≤ i ≤ s} ∪ {wj : 1 ≤ j ≤ t}  . Assume that there is at least one randomized input and that ρ ≤ mini ρ0,i when s > 0. Any fixed expression formed from these inputs by finitely many minima and maxima selects one branch and, for a selected interpolation, one atom throughout W, except with conditional probability at most S2 q∗ (8L∗ρ + η). (18) 20 Continuous noises have η = 0; for equally spaced endpoint grids η can be the largest spacing of any noise used here. The expression uses each interpolation with a single chosen sign and shift; repeated appearances of that same input are given the same name.
